items.topic: Spec is a starting point; adjust during apply
items.claim: The proposal/specs for restructure-blueprints-for-kb were treated as fixed.
items.fact: Operator: 'keep in mind if they modification you can effectively do them during apply! the proposal does not contain how actually the knowledge is built up and what does it contain it will come out as we do this'. Specs may be changed during apply as the real knowledge structure emerges; record each deviation in the change folder.

items.topic: agent-docs owned by judo-blueprint, one-time import, not in skills
items.fact: Template deleted agent-docs on develop (5bddd8b, 2026-11-03); judo-blueprint owns them. Import is one-time from 5bddd8b^ (70 non-domain docs, rendered .hbs to static markdown), no sync afterwards. Import/verification steps live only in the change folder, never in skills. A sweep that finds an agent-docs error lists it in its PR body and does not edit agent-docs; any agent-doc change needs an accepted operator-reviewed finding.

items.topic: Catalog entry format: knowledge only, no GraphQL/CLI commands, no score
items.claim: Legacy entries had score, usage_count, alternative_count, GraphQL in model.md (~1169 lines).
items.fact: Entries are descriptions + Mermaid only; no GraphQL, CLI or judo.sh commands, no build recipes. Frontmatter: projects, evidence (project@sha:path, session:<id>), first_seen, last_updated, alternatives, status derived from distinct project count (1 single-project, 2-3 emerging, >=4 established), score forbidden. Blueprint = catalog/model-blueprints/<id>/BLUEPRINT.md + model.md/backend.md/frontend.md. Best-practice sections: Description, Structure, Trade-offs, Related Patterns, Examples (+Model Definition/Backend/Frontend Implementation variants).

items.topic: Single catalog root for kb indexing
items.fact: Catalog root contains best-practices/, model-blueprints/, agent-docs/. Non-catalog (fragments/, skills/, tests/, openspec/, .pi/) is excluded. knowledge_base.json: filesystem sources catalog (priority 10) and . (priority 0); exclude fragments/**, skills/*/scripts/**, tests/**, target/**, openspec/changes/archive/**; index DB .pi/dashboard/kb/index.db is gitignored. CI runs kb eval with recall@5 threshold (set on first full index). Result: 1182 files, 8989 chunks indexed in ~12s.

items.topic: Fragments are CLI-saved .model files, not command lists
items.claim: Blueprints stored GraphQL/command recipes for building model elements.
items.fact: Each model-shaped entry declares 'fragment: <id>' and has fragments/<id>.model (outside catalog): Sandbox base plus one package bp::<id>, neutral names, written by the JUDO CLI 'save'. Diagram in entry is a generated block '<!-- mermaid:generated fragment=<id> cli=<version> -->' produced by 'mermaid model --scope' and must equal a fresh render (check fails on hand edits). CI checks all fragments after sweep/distillation, no release tag unless all pass; CLI jar never tracked in git.
items.evidence: blueprint-sandbox-validation spec; render/check run in session 14:49

items.topic: Building a fragment with judo-model-cli (verified command sequence)
items.fact: Scratch copy of Sandbox.model; alias c(){ java -jar $J -q -m Sandbox.model "$@"; }. Create: 'create -t Package -n bp --ns Sandbox --brief'; nested package with --ns Sandbox::bp; 'create -t EntityType -n AuditLog --ns <pkgFqn>'; 'create -t DataMember -n occurredAt --ns <entityFqn> -s dataType=Sandbox::types::Timestamp -s required=true -s memberType=STORED'; enumeration literals are type EnumerationMember (not EnumerationLiteral); 'update <fqn>.<member> -s dataType=<fqn>'; 'save'. '--schema' on create shows fields (e.g. 'create -t EntityType --schema'); 'query esm Package --select name'; 'validate --strict'; 'mermaid model --scope <fqn> --depth --kinds entity,enum,transfer,actor,operation --members --split aggregate|package|none --md'. --ns and -t are required (error 'Container not found' if parent package missing - create parents first). Valid -t list printed on error. Sandbox model has packages types and measures with Timestamp/String types.

items.claim: pom pinned judo-model-cli 1.1.0.20260126_071613_e7eac4ad_develop and downloaded to .claude/judo-cli.jar.

Pom now has <revision>1.0.0-SNAPSHOT</revision>, version ${revision}, jar downloaded to target/judo-cli.jar (profile download-model-cli); skills resolve CLI via $JUDO_CLI_JAR, then <repo>/target/judo-cli.jar. items.topic: Python exec of sibling script needs __file__
items.fact: Loading the extensionless 'render' script via exec(compile(...)) from 'check' failed with NameError __file__; set module.__dict__['__file__'] before exec.

pass-a script converted 308 entries to kb single-line frontmatter (title, description, aliases, keywords, tags, status, evidence, alternatives, fragment: pending, format: legacy); 0 GraphQL fences and 0 score lines left; legacy lint leaves 17 failures: 7 privacy e-mail, 4 Handlebars outside code fences, 1 judo.sh command, 5 sections >4000 chars without sub-heading. Before migration entry-lint on 567 files: 454 failed (1734 frontmatter, 310 missing sections, 147 forbidden content, 62 missing frontmatter, 8 sample project name). Evidence unrecorded ('project:unrecorded') for migrated entries. Pitfall: git checkout of a file restores GraphQL; rerun strip_graphql. Legacy entries are mostly model-blueprints 105 and ~207 best practices (model 71, backend 74, frontend 62).

items.topic: kb guard nagging and kb CLI usage
items.fact: The kb guard repeatedly emits 'Repeated source searching, still no kb consult' when using bash grep/ls; kb CLI usable via node $(npm root -g)/@blackbelt-technology/pi-dashboard-kb-extension/node_modules/@blackbelt-technology/pi-dashboard-kb/dist/cli.js with 'search <q> --limit N' and reindex; searching 'create EntityType' ranks agent-docs/frontend hooks first (old catalog content), 'audit log entity' ranks best-practices/backend/audit-event-trail.md and audit-log-entity BLUEPRINT.md.

items.topic: agent-docs render must use <app> placeholder and hand-edit rule
items.claim: Rendered agent-docs contained sample names 'myapp' and 'webshop' (i18n.md, interceptors.md, README, development-workflow).
items.fact: Model name rendered as <app> (225 occurrences); remaining 'myapp' samples in frontend/i18n.md (faults.myapp.entities.BusinessError.*, application.model.name) and backend/interceptors.md (myapp.access_management.AccessRole#_addReference...) still need fixing. Added section 'Do not edit the model file by hand': the ESM model file model/<app>.model is XMI; never edit as text, change only through the JUDO CLI.

Base version is pom 'revision' property X.Y.Z-SNAPSHOT (JUDO packages convention); branch builds on develop/feature/* get computed versions; releases are git tags; consumers pin a kb git source by tag/pin (upgrade only when pin edited), pi package installed at same tag via 'pi install git:github.com/BlackBeltTechnology/judo-blueprint@<tag>'. Release notes list added/changed/removed entry ids and fragment check count.

Pi package exports exactly judo-blueprint, judo-model-mermaid, judo-blueprint-author, judo-session-distill; judo-catalog-maintain is project-local (.pi/skills) and not exported. Distillation corpus lives outside repo (pi session JSONL v3 + optional calls*.jsonl CLI audit logs), MEMORY.md not mined, watermark per corpus for incremental runs, contributor consent record required or run stops naming the user. Sweeps update swept SHA only after merge, resume from first incomplete project.

items.topic: Machine capacity for parallel CLI sessions
items.fact: Each judo CLI session is a JVM (~100MB jar, ~1.2GB for 4 JVMs); before fanning out parallel author agents check capacity: 32 GB RAM, 10 CPU, ~7.4 GB free+inactive on the operator machine.
